claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates averaged around 6.47% to 6.57%.
30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates dipped in February 2026.
As of late March 2026, 15-year fixed mortgage refinance rates averaged approximately 5.65% to 5.90%.
According to industry forecasts, rates for 2026 are generally expected to hover near the 6% range.
In March 2026, 30-Year Fixed refinance rate averages were 6.47% - 6.625%.
In March 2026, 15-Year Fixed refinance rate averages were 5.75% - 5.90%.
In March 2026, 30-Year Fixed FHA/VA refinance rate averages were 6.29% - 6.47%.
Refinance rates hit a six-month high in late March 2026.
Refinance rates hit three-year lows in February 2026.
Liberty Bank notes that refinancing typically costs between 2% and 6% of the total loan amount.
Heritage Family Credit Union notes that a common rule of thumb for refinancing is to aim for a new rate at least two percentage points lower than your current one.
